findings.governingReading: The ruthless introduction announces the evil debt collector’s dramatic appearance.
findings.explanation: The English drops the stylized entrance call, flattening the performed opening.

findings.highlight: They pull your leg when it counts
findings.evidenceJa: ここぞって時に足を引っ張る
findings.governingReading: Such contracts impede or betray the person at the decisive moment even if that was never their intent.
findings.explanation: The English selects the wrong English idiom: pull your leg means tease or deceive, not hold someone back.

findings.highlight: right next to you where you don’t expect them
findings.evidenceJa: 意外な形で意外に身近にいる
findings.governingReading: The most frightening thing may be surprisingly close in an unexpected form.
findings.explanation: The English retains unexpected proximity but drops the separate point that the danger takes an unexpected form, which sets up Illya’s failure to recognize herself.

findings.highlight: if you stare at me so much
findings.evidenceJa: そんな熱い視線で見つめられたら
findings.governingReading: Illya mistakes Taiga’s intense or heated stare for admiring attention.
findings.explanation: The English changes the gaze’s quality into duration or amount and weakens Illya’s pleased misunderstanding.

findings.highlight: I also hear that her affection point goes up
findings.evidenceJa: 好感度があがる物があるとの噂があるっす
findings.governingReading: Illya reports a rumor that some answers raise Rin’s affection rating when Shirou resists her.
findings.explanation: The English turns a variable rating into an unnatural singular point and loosens which exchange the resistance concerns.

findings.highlight: I thought we promised not to say that
findings.evidenceJa: それは言わない約束っす
findings.governingReading: Illya protests that Taiga had agreed not to say that about her returning heroine-candidate status.
findings.explanation: The English makes the promise mutual, changing who had undertaken the obligation.

findings.evidenceJa: おのおの、心して戦いに臨まれたい！
findings.governingReading: Taiga formally exhorts each player to steel themselves and enter the coming battles.
findings.explanation: The English reduces the mock-martial exhortation to generic caution and drops the address to each participant.
